Metadata.title: Mercasa | Wholesale Distribution of Consumer Goods in Costa Rica
Metadata.description: Mercasa, a Grupo Inteca company, is a leading importer, marketer, and wholesale distributor of consumer goods in Costa Rica. Over 60 years in the market, 2 owned distribution centers, and nationwide coverage.
Metadata.ogDescription: Import, logistics, and wholesale distribution of consumer goods. A Grupo Inteca company with over 60 years in the market.

Hero.title: <accent>Costa Rica's leader</accent> in mass-market distribution and commercialization of consumer goods
Hero.paragraph: Import, logistics, and wholesale distribution of consumer goods, reaching supermarkets, retail, and local trade nationwide.
Hero.photoAlt: Mercasa warehouse: forklift moving pallets between storage racks

About.title: The <accent>reliability</accent> behind every delivery
About.paragraph: In Costa Rica's mass-consumption market, Mercasa is the bridge between international brands and local trade: a single operation that negotiates, imports, and delivers, with no extra intermediaries along the way. That integration is what sets us apart, backed by the scale and corporate discipline of {parent}, a privately held corporation with a regional footprint.
About.photoAlt: Mercasa distribution center at sunset: loading docks, pallets, and a delivery truck

Logistics.lead: We connect the world with Costa Rica through an efficient, modern, and reliable logistics chain that guarantees availability and speed on every delivery.

importacion.title: Global Import
importacion.description: We work with more than 45 suppliers across 30 countries, managing international freight and customs to the highest standards.

almacenamiento.title: Smart Warehousing
almacenamiento.description: Two owned macro distribution centers with more than 10,500 pallet positions and world-class inventory management technology.

distribucion.title: Nationwide Distribution
distribucion.description: Our own logistics network covering the entire country, optimizing routes for efficient, on-time deliveries.

puntoDeVenta.title: Point of Sale
puntoDeVenta.description: We close the loop by getting every product into the hands of the end consumer, in every corner of the country.

Logistics.heroBandAlt: Mercasa's logistics chain: ocean import, warehouse storage, truck transport, and point of sale

Brands.paragraph: We work with leading brands that guarantee quality, innovation, and wellbeing for our customers.

calidad.title: Guaranteed quality
calidad.description: Brands from the world's best manufacturers, selected to bring excellence into every home.

alianzas.title: Strategic partnerships
alianzas.description: Long-standing commercial relationships with recognized brands that trust our nationwide distribution network.

compromiso.title: Commitment to our customers
compromiso.description: We keep expanding our portfolio to meet what the Costa Rican market needs.

Contact.paragraph: Visit us at our distribution center in El Tejar, El Guarco, Cartago, or reach out directly — we serve international suppliers and local customers alike.
